notices.title: People advised to plan for storm, possible flood conditions on South Coast highways
notices.summary: Drivers in the South Coast region, including the Lower Mainland, Sunshine Coast, Vancouver Island and Fraser Valley, are advised to prepare for winds, heavy rainfall and possible flooding through the region starting Tuesday, Nov. 10, 2026, and through the rest of the week.
